facts.fact: The Gambia began issuing ID cards following biometric deduplication by Innovatrics, through a 2009 partnership with Pristine Consulting, per Biometric Update.
The Gambia issued national ID cards under the Semlex contract signed in June 2016, but cards had not been issued for many months by September 2024 after the contract ended.
